placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Prior's Wood is an Avon Wildlife Trust reserve with public paths through a varied woodland landscape. In spring the bluebells are a highlight, while other seasons reward a slower look at the trees and birds.

Our family idea: choose a short section of the main path and listen quietly before moving on. Take photographs from the path so flowers and the woodland floor remain undisturbed.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Nature-loving families comfortable on uneven paths.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Woodland footpaths; bring drinks and plan a toilet stop elsewhere.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Parking is limited. Follow the reserve's arrival guidance and respect nearby homes.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Paths can be muddy, slippery and steep-sided. Keep dogs on leads and remain on the best-used paths.

placevisitmap.travelNote: Parking is limited. Follow the reserve's arrival guidance and respect nearby homes. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
